import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, ttest_ind, fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_validate
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, average_precision_score, balanced_accuracy_score
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer

X=pd.read_csv('sensors.csv'); yraw=pd.read_csv('labels.csv')
y=(yraw.label==1).astype(int); t=pd.to_datetime(yraw.timestamp)
print('shape',X.shape,'class',y.value_counts().to_dict(),'time',t.min(),t.max(), 'missing', int(X.isna().sum().sum()))
print('class timestamp', yraw.groupby('label').timestamp.agg(['count','min','max']))
print('monthly\\n', pd.crosstab(t.dt.to_period('M'),y,normalize='index').assign(n=pd.crosstab(t.dt.to_period('M'),y).sum(1)).to_string())
# valid features
nuniq=X.nunique(dropna=True); valid=nuniq[nuniq>1].index
print('constant/all missing',len(X.columns)-len(valid),'valid',len(valid))
R=[]
for c in valid:
 a=X.loc[y==1,c].dropna(); b=X.loc[y==0,c].dropna()
 # rank-biserial / AUC probability higher in defect
 u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided'); auc=u/(len(a)*len(b))
 # standardized mean diff
 d=(a.mean()-b.mean())/np.sqrt((a.var()+b.var())/2)
 # miss odds / fisher
 tab=[[int(X.loc[y==1,c].isna().sum()), int(X.loc[y==1,c].notna().sum())], [int(X.loc[y==0,c].isna().sum()),int(X.loc[y==0,c].notna().sum())]]
 _,pm=fisher_exact(tab)
 R.append((c, float(auc),float(p),float(d),a.mean(),b.mean(),a.median(),b.median(),int(len(a)),int(len(b)),float(pm),tab[0][0],tab[1][0]))
r=pd.DataFrame(R,columns=['sensor','auc','p','smd','mean_bad','mean_good','med_bad','med_good','n_bad','n_good','p_missing','miss_bad','miss_good'])
r['q']=multipletests(r.p,method='fdr_bh')[1];r['qbonf']=multipletests(r.p,method='bonferroni')[1]
print('\\nTOP UNIVARIATE')
print(r.sort_values('p').head(30).to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f'{x:.5g}'))
print('FDR/bonf signif',sum(r.q<.05),sum(r.qbonf<.05))
print('\\nTOP missingness',r.sort_values('p_missing').head(15)[['sensor','p_missing','miss_bad','miss_good']].to_string(index=False))
# Models controlled CV
Xv=X[valid]
cv=StratifiedKFold(8,shuffle=True,random_state=2026)
for C in [.01,.03,.1,.3,1]:
 pipe=Pipeline([('imp',SimpleImputer(strategy='median',add_indicator=True)),('sc',StandardScaler()),('lr',LogisticRegression(penalty='l1',solver='liblinear',class_weight='balanced',C=C,max_iter=5000))])
 ss=cross_validate(pipe,Xv,y,cv=cv,scoring={'auc':'roc_auc','ap':'average_precision','ba':'balanced_accuracy'},return_estimator=True)
 nums=[]
 for e in ss['estimator']:
  names=np.r_[valid.values, [f'{x}__missing' for x in valid]]
  nums.append(set(names[np.abs(e.named_steps['lr'].coef_[0])>1e-8]))
 inter=set.intersection(*nums)
 print('C',C,'AUC',np.mean(ss['test_auc']),np.std(ss['test_auc']),'AP',np.mean(ss['test_ap']),'BA',np.mean(ss['test_ba']),'intersection',len(inter),sorted(inter)[:30], 'avgsel',np.mean([len(x) for x in nums]))
# final full fit C .03 ranks coef
pipe=Pipeline([('imp',SimpleImputer(strategy='median',add_indicator=True)),('sc',StandardScaler()),('lr',LogisticRegression(penalty='l1',solver='liblinear',class_weight='balanced',C=.03,max_iter=5000))]).fit(Xv,y)
names=np.r_[valid.values,[f'{x}__missing' for x in valid]]; co=pipe.named_steps['lr'].coef_[0]
print('\\nfull L1 C=.03',list(zip(names[np.argsort(abs(co))[::-1][:30]],co[np.argsort(abs(co))[::-1][:30]])))
# temporal split half performance: train earliest 70, test rest and reverse perhaps
cut=t.quantile(.7); tr=t<=cut
for trainmask,testmask,label in [(tr,~tr,'early->late'),(~tr,tr,'late->early')]:
 pp=Pipeline([('imp',SimpleImputer(strategy='median',add_indicator=True)),('sc',StandardScaler()),('lr',LogisticRegression(penalty='l1',solver='liblinear',class_weight='balanced',C=.03,max_iter=5000))]).fit(Xv[trainmask],y[trainmask])
 prob=pp.predict_proba(Xv[testmask])[:,1]
 print(label,'n',trainmask.sum(),testmask.sum(),'bad',y[trainmask].sum(),y[testmask].sum(),'auc',roc_auc_score(y[testmask],prob),'ap',average_precision_score(y[testmask],prob))
 # selected
 co=pp.named_steps['lr'].coef_[0]; print(list(zip(names[np.abs(co).argsort()[::-1][:15]],co[np.abs(co).argsort()[::-1][:15]])))
PY"
